fixture_generation_rule: Fixed inherited domain corners only, generated from declared domain extents without reading any P/Q state or observation; no random optimization or recovered state. Analytic constant/linear/quadratic arrays for representation tests. Modal fixtures are numerical/API/runtime checks, not scientific acquisition cases.
trajectory: Inherited 121 times 0:10:1200 s and 2 m/s platform with 15 degree turn after 600 s. Navigation coordinates frozen binary64 metadata; candidate trig uses certified real pi.

analytic_tests.toy: convex scalar interval compatibility with analytically specified roots

comparison_rule: For each of 4 states x 3 declared depths: binary64 modal level reconstruction twice; independent Arb160 and Arb256 real-model reconstruction; WINDOW_SHAPE_Q2 features. Measure sqrt(sum of 12 coefficient differences squared / 6). Also repeat analytic representation after declared static offsets. Maximum of all repeat/reconstruction/offset discrepancies is delta_num.

numerical_allowance.claim: Numerical/reconstruction compatibility only, no real acoustic noise claim; fixture calibration is not a uniform binary64 rounding proof. Whole-cell arithmetic itself is outward rounded Arb.

runtime_calibration.fixture: one full-domain bearing enclosure and all 21 depth-profile feature enclosures using first declared corner observation; additionally a tiny symmetric corner-adjacent cell. Runtime is diagnostic only; no contraction or recovery calibration.
runtime_calibration.cell_cost_seconds: max elapsed full-cell and tiny-cell certificate calls including all 21 profiles, minimum denominator 1e-3 s
runtime_calibration.B0_policy: same per-resolution cell request cap as CZ; no larger baseline budget selected from outcomes

grid_rule.basis: domain-relative dyadic partitions; range width 0.25 km is half nominal endpoint stability tolerance, fine halves all axes. Not based on P/Q results.
grid_rule.split: largest width / terminal maximum ratio; midpoint binary split

non_development_cell_bound_tests.containment_points: fixed root corners plus tiny-cell endpoint/midpoint; test containment only, never a rejection certificate

ordering: This file must be committed and pushed before any analytic unit fixture, modal numeric/API calibration, dependency runtime probe or tests. Immutable thereafter.
stop: PRE-RUN only. No development release, no fresh, no N1, no optimizer change, R4=0%, A2/depth/SSP/P5 unopened.
